rule: Work on one feature at a time. Complete the applicable Pre-Implementation Gate before coding. After implementing the real production path, scripts/ci.sh must pass. Then complete every applicable Production-Ready Gate item with evidence before marking passing or moving on. Scaffolds, placeholders, stubs, fake data, no-op adapters, and mocks do not satisfy production behavior.
reconciliationNote: The 2026-09-22 reconciliation audited the original 8 registered features end-to-end. This harness update adds merchant-browser-automation as a ninth PLANNED feature and corrects agentic-checkout to PARTIAL after tracing the authorization boundary: the Android biometric is local-only and its signed assertion is not verified by Convex. No feature is VERIFIED without real integration/hardware evidence; production provider paths that lack required Infisical -> Convex secrets remain fail-closed.
